latest_release.name: Mihon v0.21.3
latest_release.body:
Consider supporting the development on [Patreon](https://www.patreon.com/mihon/membership) or [OpenCollective](https://opencollective.com/mihon/contribute) to keep Mihon improving!

Check out the [past release notes](https://github.com/mihonapp/mihon/releases) if you're upgrading from an earlier version.

<!-->

> [!NOTE]
>
> ### This is the last major version to support Tachiyomi's backup format (.tachibk) and extensions made for it.
>
> After this version, Mihon won't be able to restore backups in Tachiyomi's backup format (.tachibk). The next version will also drop compatibility with extensions made for Tachiyomi (1.4 extensions). This is being done to reduce maintenance burden and simplify things for upcoming features.
>
> From the next update, the only way to restore a .tachibk backup will be to restore it on this version and then update to the latest version.

### ✨ New Features
- Added a Time Format setting to show times in 12 or 24 hour format, or to follow your language or system (Settings → Appearance) (@MajorTanya)
- Added a "Redact sensitive headers" setting (on by default) that hides login tokens from logs, so they are safe to share (Settings → Advanced) (@MajorTanya)

### ⚙️ Changes
- Library updates now start with the sources that have the most entries in your library (@AntsyLich)

### 🚀 Improvements
- Creating and restoring backups is faster and uses much less memory, so big libraries no longer run out of memory (@NGB-Was-Taken, @AntsyLich)

### 🧩 Fixes
- Fixed WebView crashing for sources that set an Origin header (@AntsyLich)
- Fixed WebView sending a source's headers to other sites (@AntsyLich)
- Fixed downloads not showing for entries of a source that shares its name with another source (@AntsyLich)
- Fixed covers reloading when removing an entry from your library (@AntsyLich)
- Fixed the More tab icon pausing and then bouncing back when leaving the tab (@AntsyLich)
- Fixed the Shizuku extension installer not being available with Sui (@AntsyLich)
- Fixed the extension update count being hidden when tab names are long, like in German (@Sahil-669, @AntsyLich)

### 🧹 Removals
- Removed the "Split tall images" download setting with it being handled in the reader directly (@AntsyLich)

### 🔧 Under the hood
- The download queue screen was rebuilt (@AntsyLich)
- Updated OkHttp, which now blocks the compromised eMudhra certificates on devices without Google Play Services (@renovate)

<!-->

## And in [v0.21.2](https://github.com/mihonapp/mihon/releases/tag/v0.21.2)

### 🧩 Fixes
- Fixed Comick showing reading progress with long decimal numbers (@MajorTanya)
- Fixed updating from v0.20.x failing on some older databases, which left the app on the updating screen or crashing on launch (@AntsyLich)
- Fixed a crash when using the back gesture while the reader or a dialog was closing (@AntsyLich)
- Fixed Kitsu login failing with "Failed to bypass Cloudflare" (@AntsyLich)
- Fixed the tracker start date being a day off when adding tracking to an entry you already read, in some timezones (@hazptr)
- Fixed the paged reader crashing when moving to another chapter with "Split wide pages" on (@AntsyLich)
- Fixed a crash when opening the filters of some sources (@AntsyLich)
- Fixed a crash when installing an extension on devices where the system installer can't ask for confirmation (@AntsyLich)
- Fixed a crash when tapping in the long strip reader as it closed (@AntsyLich)
- Fixed some chapters downloaded before v0.21.0 no longer showing as downloaded (@AntsyLich)
- Fixed the app slowing down or running out of memory when many requests to a site hit a Cloudflare challenge at once (@tigeryu8900, @AntsyLich)

<!-->
